attributes.board_name: District of Columbia Board of Medicine

rules.alternatives: NCCPA certification may substitute for the 100 hours, but the 2 hours LGBTQ cultural competency and 10 hours public health priority topics are still required.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Birth-month transition: licensees with less than two years on their license term need 50% of the CE (LGBTQ and public health hours still required).

topics.who: All PAs: topics named by the DC Health Director as public health priorities (10% of hours)

rules.notes: Licenses expire on the last day of the birth month; odd birth year renews in odd years, even in even years (transition since Jun 16, 2024). Section title from DCMR list; rule text itself not opened.
